method.traced: Task 18. Source px of brochure-2bhk.png. Each room's polygon is the face of the verified wall truth (brochure-2bhk.drawing-walls.json) that holds its point, polygonized and simplified by 0.5 px. The kitchen and the living room share one truth face through the kitchen's open side (x 152, y 215-245, no truth wall: see the openings truth's not_listed note): the kitchen is its part left of x 152 and the living room the rest.
method.points: Interior points lie on the room's floor colour away from lines, furniture outlines and labels (9 x 9 px window minimum: >= 199 on the bedroom, living, kitchen and toilet fills; 130 on the deck's wood-grain fill, median 148; wall poche reads 85-105 and line work under 80).
method.labels: As printed: BEDROOM (2), DECK, LIVING/DINING, KITCHEN, TOILET (2); every label has a replayed OCR token inside its room.
method.open: kitchen: open onto the living room through its 30 px side opening without a door. The deck opens to the living room through folding doors (a door, so not open).
method.not_rooms: The OTS (x 247-341, y 236-311), the hatched 6'6" x 7'0" shaft right of the right toilet, the 5'8" strip left of the left toilet and kitchen, and the corridor lie outside the flat's outline (no truth wall encloses them): a face there is neither matched nor counted against.
judgement_calls: Kitchen cut-out: the kitchen and the living room are one face of the wall truth (the kitchen's open side x 152, y 215-245 carries no truth wall); the kitchen's polygon is that face's part left of x 152 and the living room's the rest. The kitchen is open onto the living room (opens_onto living).
The OTS, the hatched shaft, the 5'8" strip and the corridor are not rooms (outside the flat's outline): see not_rooms.
